The self-test uses a synthetic three-channel matrix and checks arithmetic, determinism, strict numeric parsing, matrix conditioning gates, nonblocking regular-file intake, short writes, create-new pair publication, and rollback boundaries only.
FCS parsing, matrix estimation or selection, transformations, gating, labeling, spectral unmixing, and biological interpretation are outside the package.
Cross-platform floating-point byte identity was not established.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The matrix row/column convention is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: Does each matrix row represent a true source channel and each matrix column the matching observed channel?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use the producer-approved matrix in source-row by observed-column form; do not infer, transpose, or relabel it.

runtime_versions: Python 3.12.8 self-test; compatible syntax requires Python >=3.10
